demo.code:
holdtil refill
→ Float $0.40 < floor $1.00. Asked Holdtil ($0.01): sell 0.0175 NVDAc, fair floor $2.49.
→ Bankr quote $2.51 ≥ floor. Swapped with 0.79% slippage. Got $2.51 USDC. Tx: 0x…

holdtil refill (Saturday)
→ Holdtil says wait: NVDA price 40 h old, market closed. Nothing sold.

setup: Hold some NVDAc (Coinbase tokenized NVIDIA) on Base in your Bankr wallet, and pass Bankr's location check.
Tell your agent the Holdtil check URL and your floor, target and max refill (defaults $1 / $3 / $2).
Set Bankr Security limits (e.g. $2 per transaction, $5 a day) as a hard cap.
Say "holdtil refill" whenever you want a top-up.
